title: Conjunctions (Theme 7: Safety)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 3 English; not yet checked by a Kenyan English teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child asks "Do the ideas agree, pull apart, or give a reason?" and chooses and, but or because.

board.do: Write: The road was busy ___ we crossed safely.

board.say: Which word fits? and, but or because?

board.do: Wait for the child to choose.
The child writes the word in the gap.
Read: The road was busy but we crossed safely.

listen_for: I was hungry because I ate.
Because it was raining. (written alone as the sentence)
misconceptions.repair: Join it to the main idea.

checks.question: I wore a helmet ___ it keeps me safe.
Join: I was tired. I finished my work. (but)
checks.answer: I was tired but I finished my work.
